Demand for inference is outrunning the construction of new AI data centers, as power, capital and permitting delays push fresh capacity further out. That gap is sending chipmakers to hunt for room in existing facilities. Many older telco and colocation sites have the space and power. But most can’t take today’s dense, liquid-cooled GPU racks […]

The post Stalled data center buildouts send inference chips hunting for space in telco and colo sites appeared first on SiliconANGLE.
